note: Smithers' root scripts run `pnpm exec smthrs target '//:targetIndex' --write` and `smthrs flow start docs-sync`. smthrs is @smthrs/cli's Node bin, which loads packages/smithers/src; once src/internal/ControlNdjson was .vibe, `pnpm run target-index` failed loading NodeControl.ts -> ./internal/ControlNdjson.vibe, since smthrs runs without vibelang's loader (audit62-smithers, 2026-11-02).

files.packages/cli/src/main.ts:
import { NodeControl } from "@smthrs/smithers/NodeControl"
export const main = async (args: string[]) => NodeControl.run(args)
files.packages/smithers/src/NodeControl.ts:
import { lines } from "./internal/ControlNdjson.ts"
export const NodeControl = { run: (args: string[]) => lines(args) }
